destination.name: Longquan
destination.tagline: A mountain town of Song-dynasty celadon and ancient swordmaking, near Baishanzu
destination.description: Longquan is a town in southwest Zhejiang best known for celadon porcelain, made here since the Song dynasty, and for swordmaking that goes back several hundred years BCE. A kiln site and a celadon museum show how the glaze is made. A sword factory and museum cover the blade tradition. To the south, the Baishanzu reserve holds Zhejiang's highest peak, Huangmaojian.

goodToKnow.title: Go via Lishui
goodToKnow.detail: From Shanghai, a high-speed train to Lishui and then a bus of about 1.5 hours is the popular route. A direct bus takes 6 to 7 hours.

goodToKnow.title: Baishanzu lies south
goodToKnow.detail: Baishanzu lies about 27 km south of the centre, in the mountains where Zhejiang's highest peak stands.

destination.bestTimeBlurb: Best in {months}, with mild weather for kilns and mountains. June is the wettest.
